assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, supporting the medical necessity of the mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).

Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes, consistent with the diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R42.
The diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R42 are cited.
The service aligns with the documented clinical indication.
